name: Heroku
subtitle: Original Git-push PaaS
creator: James Lindenbaum, Adam Wiggins and Orion Henry
description: The platform that popularized deploying with git push. In February 2026 Salesforce moved Heroku to a sustaining engineering model: it keeps running and gets security fixes, but no new features are planned.

languages.youWrite: Node, Ruby, Python, Java, PHP, Go and more via buildpacks

concepts.explanation: Lightweight containers that run your app.

codeSamples.label: Shell + Procfile
codeSamples.code:
# Procfile
web: gunicorn myproject.wsgi

# Terminal
heroku create my-app
heroku addons:create heroku-postgresql:essential-0
git push heroku main

pricing.summary: No free tier since 2022. Eco dynos $5/mo (sleep when idle), Basic $7/mo, Postgres from $5/mo.

flags: Sustaining engineering (no new features) since Feb 2026

surveys.source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, all respondents
